data.one_liner: Serve Swagger UI API documentation using Shelf.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Swagger UI into a Shelf server to present clean and professional API documentation. It allows configuring handlers directly from YAML or JSON schema files.
use_when: You are building a backend API in Dart using the shelf package
You need to serve Swagger UI documentation for your OpenAPI specs
avoid_when: You are not using the shelf package for your Dart backend
You need client-side code generation rather than server documentation rendering
strengths: Supports loading schema directly from files
Supports custom titles and configuration options like syntax highlighting and doc expansion
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside basic file loading
Dependent on external OpenAPI schema files being correctly formatted
data.setup_notes: Requires an OpenAPI schema file (YAML or JSON) and a running Shelf server.
